method: static source inspection; gateway compile blocked, no runtime exploit test
finding: TenantId reads x-tenant-id and defaults when absent; auth middleware injects UserInfo without validating or rewriting this header. Authenticated identity and requested tenant can differ. Partitioned maps alone do not prove authorization.
required_checks: derive tenant from enabled trusted UserInfo extension
reject missing trusted identity and header/identity mismatch
scope sessions, jobs, history, favorites and audit reads, not only registry and graph
